resolution.question: Neighbors Bill and the Osei family disagree over who pays for a storm-damaged shared fence. Will they agree on a cost split, without going to small claims, within two months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Bill and the Osei family have both agreed to a specific cost split (e.g., 50-50 or another proportion) and have communicated that agreement to each other. Resolve NO if no such agreement is recorded by the cutoff.
